blockers.error: package does not write mask coverage assets: hsk-studio-package read.rs tile_digests (and the write path) collect only Payload::Raster tile digests, so a document whose layers carry appearance-mask (or smart-filter mask) coverage tiles saves without those assets and reopens refused missing_asset (session render_assets); masked documents therefore cannot round-trip through a package in the harness

next: validator round on d8a2451..f448633; package owner: write mask coverage assets (then the viewer proof can add a masked layer: the stitching path is in place)
